items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT on ETR Sunday fantasy injuries report for Week 3.
items.why: Hamstring; official designation in comprehensive IN/Q/D/OUT list.
items.implication: Houston WR targets redistribute; Schultz saw 28-30% target share last week without him.
items.opportunity: TE/WR target spike for remaining pass-catchers.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday’s game.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; positive longer-term notes (no surgery/IR).
items.opportunity: Commanders WR/TE usage under backup QB.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle for Sunday’s game vs. the Bengals due to his toe injury. Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder).
items.implication: Warren to lead RB group per coach comments.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/carries/checkdowns for Warren; Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Puka Nacua will not practice and listed doubtful vs Broncos; McVay believes barring setback he could return next week vs Eagles.
items.implication: Not expected to play; Adams carries load.
items.opportunity: Adams routes/target rate spike (historically 42% target rate sans Nacua).

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in despite QUESTIONABLE tags; hoping early clarity on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.why: ETR internal projections as of Friday night.
items.implication: Startable if confirmed; monitor for changes.

items.text: Broncos ruled out RB Jonah Coleman (ankle); RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams.
items.implication: Full backfield available; Coleman out reverses prior handcuff hype.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead the Steelers RB group; expecting checkdown spam from Rodgers as vertical game has failed. Projecting Warren (Q, shoulder) in. Backups Homer and Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach: Warren lead + breathers; vertical pass ineffective.
items.implication: High volume RB2/flex with receiving upside.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + zillion checkdowns; elevated snaps.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 games in 3 seasons); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 utilization), AJ Dillon primary backup.

Loves Chase Brown (@PIT: 20+ touches/15% targets both games, PIT allows 5th-most RB rush yds); Chris Olave (vs LV: double-digit tgts, 53% air yards, LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz (@IND: 28% tgt share sans Collins, IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.implication: Start with confidence; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT.
items.opportunity: High touches/targets; TE target share spike.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in missed games: strong production including multi-TD.
items.why: Historical routes/target rate data when Nacua out.
items.implication: Adams WR1 ceiling elevated with Nacua doubtful.
items.opportunity: High route share and target rate (42%).

items.text: Projections live for Week 3; Jahmyr Gibbs has set a new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.implication: Elite DFS/tournament upside and weekly smash potential.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Rushing volume vs weak run D.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, JAX stout vs RBs); Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara); Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest WR fantasy pts allowed, low team total).
items.implication: Sit or fade; Etienne IN but limited role.
items.conflict: Etienne listed IN by ETR but low opportunity.

items.text: 10 Facts: Post-fumble, Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched Stevenson 16-5 rest of game (still ranks Stevenson ahead); Schultz 30% routes targeted/28% share sans Collins; London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 ypg in 12 games w/ Penix.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not lead yet; Schultz/London strong.
items.opportunity: Henderson snaps rising; Schultz targets; London with Penix.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Stevenson over Henderson short-term.
